text:
Maria Chen: Heads up — ACME user request to delete all PII arrived but we also have an active vuln triage that references the same dataset. Legal hold likely needed, can we avoid accidental purge?
Ajay Patel: Ticket #6582? link? Need scope: user id or entire org?
Maria Chen: Ticket 6582 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRIV-6582). It's a single user: user_id=acme|u-9a3f. The vuln triage team pulled a snapshot and noted potential exfil indicators.
Omar Ruiz: OK. We can't satisfy the DSAR deletion until forensics completes. Proposal: create a short-term retention exception + immutable snapshot for forensic review, plus RBAC lift for the forensic agent.
Elaine Park: Agree. Two operational pieces: 1) retention exception in Privacypath, 2) create encrypted snapshot that legal/forensics can access but ops cannot delete. Note: our KMS integration doesn't allow raw key export. We'll need to encrypt snapshot with a new CMK and restrict who can decrypt.
Tori Gomez: Legal: do NOT delete anything until we confirm. We need an auditable manifest of what was retained and why. Also need evidence chain for court if required.
Maria Chen: Suggested retention exception metadata: reason=\"legal hold + vuln triage\", requester=\"legal@acme.com\", scope=user:acme|u-9a3f, until=2026-04-15 (tentative). Also need an audit tag in the request.
Omar Ruiz: I'll create the snapshot and encrypt with a new key ring key 'forensics-acme-u9a3f' in KMS. We will set key IAM to only allow 'forensics-service-account@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com' to decrypt. Ops/service accounts should be denied.
Ajay Patel: For the RBAC change we should do a short-lived role binding instead of permanent. Use role 'roles/privacy.forensicsViewer' scoped to the service account and set expiration via our iam-proxy TTL.
Elaine Park: Terraform snippet for the RBAC change (for reference):

```hcl
resource \"google_project_iam_binding\" \"forensics_temp\" {
  project = var.project_id
  role    = \"roles/privacy.forensicsViewer\"
  members = [\"serviceAccount:forensics-service-account@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"]
}
# ensure we add a note in audit log with reason=legal-hold-PRIV-6582
```

Maria Chen: And the retention exception API call (internal) — copy below, run from infra-admin: 

```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://privacypath.redwood/api/v1/retention_exceptions" -d '{"scope":"user:acme|u-9a3f","reason":"legal hold + vuln triage","expires_at":"2026-04-15T00:00:00Z","ticket":"PRIV-6582","audit_note":"forensic snapshot created on 2026-03-22"}'
```

Tori Gomez: legal-team-bot: please attach a hold reference and expected reviewer contact.
legal-team-bot: Hold acknowledged. Assigned matter ID LHM-9932. Please include manifest path in evidence store.
sec-bot: Created internal task 33441 for KMS key creation + snapshot store.
Ajay Patel: One more: ensure our audit logging captures the exact KMS key version used and the object checksum. Add fields: kms_key_id, kms_key_version, snapshot_sha256 to the retention exception record.
Omar Ruiz: Will do. We'll push the snapshot to gs://forensics-hold-acme/LHM-9932/u-9a3f-2026-03-22.tar.gz.enc and record checksum + kms metadata.
Maria Chen: Quick note — there is a small RBAC limitation: platform deletion pipelines check 'data-delete:write' scope. We should add an explicit 'do_not_delete' tag that the purge job respects. I'll open infra PR to respect retention_exception tags.
Elaine Park: For the infra PR, add unit tests to assert purge skip when exception present. Also add e2e that simulates a deletion attempt and verifies audit entry.
Tori Gomez: Legal will review LHM-9932 this afternoon and confirm hold length.
Ajay Patel: I'll implement the short-lived IAM binding + update the Privacypath record with kms metadata. Action items: Ajay (RBAC binding), Omar (snapshot + kms), Maria (retention exception + purge flag), Elaine (infra PR/tests), Tori/Legal (confirm hold). I'll post status update in 2 hours. :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: Thanks — marking PRIV-6582 as blocked->on-hold and adding links to LHM-9932.
Omar Ruiz: Snapshot complete, uploading checksum now.
Ajay Patel: added temporary IAM binding with TTL 6h, noted in audit.
Maria Chen: resolved for now — keeping hold until legal confirms. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
